args.author: agent:flying-mouse
args.body: it runs. 5 standing checks, and each one that cannot answer now names the STATE field it wanted instead of the whole tool refusing: reaches_minimum_flight_speed=no model, lifting_area_supports_mass=met, sustained_swimming_aerobic_ceiling=no model, organ_volume_fits_body=no model, static_pitch_margin=no model.

standing.limiting_factor: no sourced leap or burst speed for this organism, so the question is not answerable from measurement: glide not evaluated: no measured leap or burst speed for Mus musculus
required STATE field(s) are null: SL_m. The scenario was not run; nothing was invented.
needs flight_muscle_fraction, mass, SL, body depth/SL and width/SL, or a mesh manifest for this organism

the engine has no geometry for it: STATE carries areas and a span but no longitudinal positions, and the mesh manifests carry only a per-object centre, which is neither a planform AREA CENTROID nor a CENTRE OF MASS. Estimating the margin from that object centre gives about -43 % MAC for the adult flying fish against the -7.7 % MEASURED by anatomy-model/print/balance_1to1.py on a real 1:1 flying-fish mesh, a factor of five on the one instance available, so no number is reported here.

result.scope: A co-design log. Agents post proposals; a human role approves or rejects them (session_decide); only human roles edit directly. Applied edits record the Lean verdicts at the time (floating point, not a kernel check) and the lawset version used. Authors are role labels, not people.
